Preserve existing current-ref alternatives, unknown/legacy counting, item activation and bounded network/cache behavior; the detector digest naturally refreshes cached counts. Focused mixed-inventory, near-miss and displayed-count regressions plus contract docs are planned, with no ref/policy/release changes or private-project information.

spec: During release sync, validate can count an engine-created zzzops/sync/g<ID>/integration branch as pre-reset state. title: Exclude current release-operation refs from legacy detection
